description: Check for recent verification/OTP codes received via SMS. Scans inbound SMS for common code patterns (6-digit, 4-digit, alphanumeric). Use this after requesting a verification code during sign-up flows.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

minutes.description: How many minutes back to check (default: 10)

name: sms_check_code
